resources.string: Only your authorized individual microphone is used to create or improve your voiceprint. Limits: %1$d seconds per clip, %2$d seconds per session and %3$d seconds per rolling 24 hours. Unconfirmed audio is kept for at most %4$d hours; after confirmation and feature extraction, audio is removed promptly. Delete samples and your voiceprint for this scope in voiceprint settings.
A clip may contain other people\'s voices. Listen and confirm your own clips before they enter the voiceprint library. Voiceprint sampling and full-call recording require separate authorization.
Declare the device you actually use. Saving a device or changing sharing pauses sampling; allowing this call requires a separate action.
Remaining: %1$d seconds in this session, %2$d seconds per rolling 24 hours
More than one voice was detected, so sampling is paused. Check that only you use this microphone and review your clips before allowing sampling again.

Authorize future call sampling separately in voiceprint settings.
